01About me

Clarity for the complex.

I help growing teams replace reactive work with reliable systems. My background spans 10+ years in BPO operations, training, workforce management, and customer support — giving me a practical view of what it takes to keep people, processes, and performance moving together.

I built a Workforce Management department from zero: no software, no precedent, and no playbook. Through self-directed research, structured spreadsheets, and AI-assisted workflows, I created the operating system that supported a 15-person team across multiple countries.

“Build the system once. Make it useful every day.”

— Roland’s operating principle
